text:
Maya (Product): Quick sync — we need a design decision on console analytics: per-route / per-model views, filters, and saved queries. Do we ship a wide ad-hoc query box or a curated set of per-route dashboards + saved-query UX?

Sam (Eng-Platform): Prefer curated per-route dashboards with flexible filters. Full ad-hoc is expensive on the infra side. We can support ad-hoc but route it to a different backend tier.

Jin (Frontend): UX thought: saved queries should be first-class — list with sharing, pinning, and a quick filter chip bar (model, model_version, rollout). Autocomplete for model names. Keep the main view lightweight.

Olivia (Analytics): Telemetry note: our events include route, model, model_version, deployment_id. We don't currently tag model_variant; if we want per-model views + rollouts we should add variant/tag field. Also we should standardize route naming (service:path) to avoid cardinality explosion.

Carlos (Eng-API): API sketch: GET /api/v1/analytics/query?saved_id=ID OR POST /api/v1/analytics/query with body {"filters": {"route":"/chat/send","model":"redwood-7b","time_range":"24h"}}. Response should support streaming partial results + total_count for large group-bys. Example: ```json
{
  "status":"partial",
  "buckets": [...],
  "continuation_token": "abc123"
}
```

Maya (Product): On saved-queries: what's the minimal data model? Owner, name, filter expression, default time window, visibility (private/team/org)? Also need an audit trail.

Sam (Eng-Platform): Minimal saved_query: id, owner_id, org_id, name, filters (list), default_time_range, pinned(boolean), visibility(enum: private/team/org). Add can_edit/can_view computed via RBAC. Implementation: store in Postgres + reference to precomputed agg table keys for fast queries.

Jin (Frontend): For the UI: a left rail "Saved views" with thumbnails, created_by, last_run, and small sparkline. In the main canvas show active filters as chips with quick-edit dropdowns. Add a "Save as" flow and an option to make view public to team.

Olivia (Analytics): One warning: free-text route filters will create high-cardinality queries. We should encourage structured route tags (service, endpoint) and provide an option to collapse by prefix. Also add quotas on ad-hoc compute to prevent cost spikes.

Carlos (Eng-API): Performance: implement hourly pre-agg for common dimensions (route, model, model_version) and realtime rollups for last 1h. For heavy ad-hoc queries, enforce a 30s compute limit and return partial results + an "in_progress" state in the UI. Also pre-warm caches for saved queries with a schedule.

Maya (Product): Sounds good. Action items: Olivia to add model_variant tag and suggest route naming conventions; Sam to spec backend pre-agg & quotas; Carlos to formalize the query API and partial results contract; Jin to mock saved-views rail and chips. I'll own the product acceptance criteria + copy.

Sam (Eng-Platform): +1 on ownership. Also propose a metric to track: % queries served from pre-agg vs ad-hoc. Helps measure cost.

Jin (Frontend): UI question — should saved queries support parameterization (like default time or variable model)? could be useful for reuse.

Olivia (Analytics): Parameterization is great but increases complexity. Maybe v1: variables only for time_range and top-k, not free filters.

Maya (Product): Agreed, v1 conservative. We'll iterate after telemetry on adoption. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

console-bot: Reminder: meeting notes saved to #product-docs and todos created in Linear under "Console analytics - saved views"

Carlos (Eng-API): I'll open a PR for the API spec today and link here.

Maya (Product): Perfect — ping when PR is up and we can do a quick review pass. :eyes:
